inputs.approval_source: mean of 6 adults-sample approval poll(s) in the 14 days to 2026-09-07. Gallup interviewed adults, and so does this average; the residual house effect between Gallup and the rest of the adults field is under two points and cannot be re-measured now that Gallup has stopped polling, so it is left in the error bar rather than corrected for (Silver Bulletin poll list, aggregate only)
inputs.income_source: FRED income_growth_ytd as of 2026-09-07, 7 month(s) of the year in hand
